The vault supplies LsETH as collateral on blue-chip lending protocols and borrows GENIUS-aligned stablecoins at a controlled loan-to-value. Proceeds are deployed into KPK's curated stablecoin vaults, capturing the spread between stablecoin lending yields and borrow costs. Returns accrue in LsETH, on top of native staking yield. Risk is managed in layers. At the strategy level, automated agents deleverage the position at predefined thresholds, well before protocol liquidation levels, and can exit it entirely under adverse conditions. The underlying KPK vaults add a second layer: their own 24/7 automation, exposure caps and liquidity buffers. Vault NAV is computed by KPK's open-source onchain accounting system, and updates to the recorded share price are bounded onchain, so pricing is independently verifiable rather than operator-attested.
